headline: Allegion to Attend 2026 Mizuho Industrials & Chemicals Conference
summary: DUBLIN, August 05, 2026--Allegion plc (NYSE: ALLE) Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer Mike Wagnes will discuss the company’s long-term strategy at the 2026 Mizuho Industrials & Chemicals Conference on Wednesday, August 12. The conference will be held at the Mandarin Oriental in New York City.
